name: Stateful Button for shadcn/ui
summary: shadcn/ui button component with spinner and progress modes that shows idle, loading, success and error states for async actions.
description: A single button component installed as source code with the shadcn CLI. It moves through idle, loading/progress, success and error states during Promise-based actions, driven by an XState finite state machine, with ARIA messages for screen readers. Spinner is the default mode; progress mode takes a controlled 0-100 value.
contains: button component with idle, loading, success and error states
spinner mode and controlled progress mode (0-100)
XState finite state machine for state transitions
ARIA messages and screen reader support
installed as source code with the shadcn CLI
custom shadcn registry for the component
